story: A VIP executive reports their email client keeps crashing. The agent must identify the user (noting VIP status for priority bump), check for known issues (finds a known issue about large attachments), run application diagnostics, get resolution steps, and create a ticket with at least High priority due to VIP status. This tests the full troubleshooting flow with VIP priority handling.

args.description: VIP user reporting email client crashes. Known issue KI-101 (large attachments). Diagnostic: memory leak in attachment renderer. Applied workaround and resolution steps.

starting_sentence: I'm vip.exec@company.com, my email client keeps crashing — I can't send any messages
